title: Experts
description: Create and manage your AI experts, or start from a template
deleteConfirm: Delete this expert? Published versions will be archived. Existing tasks are retained.
downloaded: The expert and its dependencies are saved. Review before use.
pending: The previous outcome is unconfirmed. Check the original operation first.
failed: The operation did not finish. Refresh and inspect the current state.
setup: Enable expert management on this target to continue.
busy: The target is running tasks. Try again when it is idle.
unavailable: Expert management is unavailable on this target.
inert: Downloaded skills start disabled. Review, enable and save them in Personalization → Skills; tasks using this expert read the saved settings next turn.
name: Name
templateToggleHint: Make the template available. This does not start tasks or call models.
noFiles: This expert has no downloaded files.
emptyDescription: An expert is an AI assistant with an identity and skills. Create one or choose a built-in or market template.

emptyGuide.detail1: Each expert keeps its identity, instructions and skill files.
emptyGuide.detail2: Create a blank expert template and edit its configuration.
emptyGuide.detail3: Choose a built-in or market template to get started.

teams.title: My teams
teams.membersHint: This stage stores the member list. Team orchestration and conversations are not enabled.
teams.emptyDescription: Prepare experts with different skills, then create a team and save its member list.
teams.detail1: A team stores a group of experts on the selected runtime target.
teams.detail2: Prepare at least two experts, then select team members.
teams.detail3: This stage stores configuration without starting team conversations or tasks.

customIdHint: Leave blank to generate an ID. The ID identifies the stored expert and cannot be changed later.
welcomeHint: Stored as a template preference in this stage.
avatarHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to 5 MB. Uses the accent icon when unset.
avatarInvalid: Use a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF up to 5 MB.
colorHint: Choose the color used in expert cards and avatars.
defaultModeHint: Stored as a preference without starting conversations or tasks.
storageRootHint: Managed per account and workspace on the runtime target. Downloaded content gains no host file access.
genericDescription: Start with a blank template and editable instructions, then add skills as needed.
customIdInvalid: Use 3–64 letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens, beginning and ending with a letter or number.
settingsTooLarge: Template settings are too large. Reduce the avatar, tags or other settings (16 KiB maximum).
defaultWelcome: Share what's on your mind — work or life
libraryHint: Built-in templates are bundled with the project. Creating a copy saves every file in the selected target’s private store.

personalization.title: Personalization
personalization.description: Manage experts, skills, tools, plugins, channels, personality, and memory
personalization.readFailed: Unable to read expert skills. Retry.
personalization.writeFailed: Save did not complete. Check the content, revision and total skill instruction size.
personalization.noSkillsDescription: Create a custom skill — the agent will use it at the right moment.
personalization.packageHint: Review downloaded skill files before saving. Enabled instructions are read for the task’s next turn.
personalization.noPackageSkills: No additional skills in this expert package.
personalization.enableHint: After enabling and saving, tasks using this expert load the skill entry and read supporting files as needed from the next turn. Running turns keep their original configuration. The runtime target still controls tool permissions.
personalization.importFileHint: Accepts SKILL.md or exported JSON as entry instructions only, without supporting files. Download complete skill packages from the skill market. Imported skills remain disabled until reviewed.
personalization.verifyChannelHint: Send “test” in the Feishu bot conversation, then read and bind the observed sender. You can then send a test message to the verified conversation.
personalization.associateExpertHint: Choose an observed Feishu account and a saved expert version. New messages use that immutable version.
personalization.expertScoped: Configuration, skills and fixed versions for this expert
personalization.enterFromExpert: Open Personalization from an expert card to configure it.
personalization.channelVersionRequired: Choose a saved expert version before connecting a channel. Save a version in the expert editor first if needed.
personalization.channelNeedsSave: This connection does not use the selected expert version. Unlink existing account grants before saving and linking this expert channel.
personalization.channelPendingIdentity: After connecting the bot, confirm the observed Feishu account below. Only a verified account binding routes new messages to this expert.

task.prepareHint: Choose a saved version. This opens an ordinary KCoder task; execution starts when you send your request.
task.saveVersionFirst: Save a version in the expert editor before using it.
task.historyEmpty: No tasks have been started with this expert.
task.historyPartial: The task list is incomplete or unavailable. Refresh it or check the original target.
task.channelReadOnly: This channel conversation is read-only here. Viewing it sends no messages.
task.localNew: New local task with this expert
task.nextTurnHint: Selection takes effect next turn. The running turn, task history and channel binding are retained. Saved personalization is read automatically for each new turn.
task.switchUnavailable: Unable to read this task's expert configuration. Please try again.
task.noUsageHistory: No captured expert configurations yet. Earlier turns are not assigned inferred versions.

conversation.welcome: Select a conversation, or use + beside an expert to start one
conversation.noGhost: Viewing an expert does not create an empty conversation.
conversation.originalHistory: Original conversations grouped by expert, outside the home task list.
conversation.placeholder: Say something to your AI assistant…
conversation.teamUnavailable: Team conversations are not connected yet
conversation.cloudUnavailable: Cloud experts are not connected yet
conversation.actionFailed: The action did not complete. Try again.

toolAccessHint: Use the expert’s tool selection, or inherit Luna when no custom list is set. Global restrictions, enabled skills, model capabilities and execution permissions still apply.
toolNamesHint: Use actual tool identifiers. An empty list selects no tools. A selection cannot enable globally disabled or unregistered tools.

toolSettings.explanation: Switches automatically save this expert’s selection. The first change creates a custom allowlist; select “Inherit Luna defaults” to follow the target again.
toolSettings.saved: Tool settings saved. Tasks using this expert read them next turn.
toolSettings.published: Expert version saved and available when creating a new task.
toolSettings.failed: Save did not complete. Refresh and check the current version and revision.
toolSettings.pending: The save result is unconfirmed. Reconcile the original operation before submitting again.
toolSettings.loadFailed: Unable to read this project’s tools. Refresh to retry.
toolSettings.truncated: The tool catalog is incomplete. Refresh before editing.
toolSettings.publishFailed: The tool draft was saved, but the new version was not published. Check the version name and retry.
toolSettings.outsideBaseline: Outside the expert’s Luna tool scope
toolSettings.baselineUnknown: This target does not report the expert’s Luna tool scope. Upgrade the target and refresh; the scope cannot currently be confirmed or edited.
toolSettings.previewHint: Switches save this expert’s selection. The new-task preview also applies target mode defaults, the Luna baseline and enabled-skill restrictions. Existing tasks keep their own saved tool selection; actual execution also checks permissions.
toolSettings.independentPreviewHint: Expert tasks use this selection, inheriting Luna only when no custom list is set. The preview reflects target, mode and skill restrictions. Tool calls still require permission.
